title: StateSpaceSIR: state-space surplus production models fitted by sampling-importance-resampling
description:
An R package that fits Bayesian state-space generalized logistic (surplus production) models using the sampling-importance-resampling algorithm of McAllister et al. (1994), following Zerbini et al. (2011, 2019) and Romero et al. (2022).

Combines catch series with absolute and relative abundance indices, supports multivariate lognormal index likelihoods with analytically integrated catchability, and implements four parameterisations of a demographic Allee effect (depensation). Provides model averaging by Bayes factor, WAIC, and plotting and summary methods.

Developed for southern right whales (Eubalaena australis) in the southwestern Atlantic Ocean, but applicable to other depleted populations.
